name: [Open Beta] Legend Piece
desc:
Welcome to Legend Piece
Either become a swordsman or a powerful fruit user as you train to become the strongest player.

🎮CONTROLS
Q - Dash
Ctrl - Sprint/Run
Double spacebar - SkyJump
F - Flash Step
J - Armament
K - Observation
H - Conqueror's Eye

🎁 Join our group for extra rewards: https://www.roblox.com/groups/13073914
👏 Join the Legend Piece community server for more codes, and for more information!
